The '''Pacanth Reach''' was a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] controlled by the [[Epicanthix]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Its [[Planet/Legends|planets]] included [[Panatha]] (the Epicanthix homeworld), [[Fornow]], [[Ravaath]], [[Sorimow]], and [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]].
